Layout.title: Parley
Layout.description: Situational language learning through immersive roleplay

SetupForm.heading: Start a new session
SetupForm.subheading: Pick a language, choose your challenge, and jump in
SetupForm.step1Title: What language do you want to practice?
SetupForm.step1Subtitle: Pick the language you want to learn
SetupForm.step2Subtitle: Choose a situation to practice in {language}

Scenarios.taxi_description: A chatty driver and a suspiciously high meter
Scenarios.taxi_goal_beginner: Tell the driver your hotel name and understand the price
Scenarios.taxi_goal_intermediate: Negotiate a fair price for the ride to your hotel
Scenarios.taxi_goal_advanced: Negotiate the fare, strike up a conversation about local life, and get restaurant recommendations
Scenarios.taxi_goal_impossible: Convince the driver to give you a free ride using only proverbs and regional dialect, then have them recite a poem about their hometown
Scenarios.cafe_description: A cozy cafe with an unreadable menu
Scenarios.cafe_goal_beginner: Order a coffee and point at a pastry to buy it
Scenarios.cafe_goal_intermediate: Order a full breakfast and ask about ingredients
Scenarios.cafe_goal_advanced: Order for yourself and a friend with dietary restrictions, and ask about the cafe's history
Scenarios.cafe_goal_impossible: Convince the barista to teach you their secret recipe, debate the philosophy of coffee roasting, and get hired on the spot as a part-time barista
Scenarios.lost_description: Dead phone, no map, need to find the station
Scenarios.lost_goal_beginner: Ask where the train station is and understand if it's far
Scenarios.lost_goal_intermediate: Get detailed directions including landmarks and street names
Scenarios.lost_goal_advanced: Get directions, ask about the neighborhood, and understand a local's recommendation for a shortcut
Scenarios.lost_goal_impossible: Get the stranger to abandon their plans and personally walk you to the station while you settle a heated debate about which neighborhood has the best architecture
Scenarios.market_description: Vibrant stalls and a persistent vendor
Scenarios.market_goal_beginner: Ask the price and buy one item
Scenarios.market_goal_intermediate: Haggle the price down and buy a souvenir
Scenarios.market_goal_advanced: Negotiate a bulk purchase, learn about the craft, and get the vendor to throw in a bonus item
Scenarios.market_goal_impossible: Persuade the vendor to become your business partner, draft the terms of a joint venture on a napkin, and convince them their prices have been wrong all along
Scenarios.hotel_description: Your reservation has vanished from the system
Scenarios.hotel_goal_beginner: Say your name and show your booking confirmation
Scenarios.hotel_goal_intermediate: Sort out the reservation issue and get your room
Scenarios.hotel_goal_advanced: Resolve the booking error, negotiate a room upgrade for the inconvenience, and ask about hotel amenities
Scenarios.hotel_goal_impossible: Get a free upgrade to the presidential suite, convince the manager the hotel owes you emotional damages, and leave with a lifetime loyalty card
Scenarios.doctor_description: Feeling unwell at a foreign clinic
Scenarios.doctor_goal_beginner: Point to where it hurts and understand if you need medication
Scenarios.doctor_goal_intermediate: Describe your symptoms clearly and understand the treatment plan
Scenarios.doctor_goal_advanced: Give detailed medical history, discuss treatment options, and ask about side effects
Scenarios.doctor_goal_impossible: Diagnose yourself more accurately than the doctor using only medical jargon, then convince them to let you do their rounds for the day
Scenarios.friends_description: A curious local at a cultural event
Scenarios.friends_goal_beginner: Introduce yourself and say where you're from
Scenarios.friends_goal_intermediate: Have a fun conversation and exchange contact info
Scenarios.friends_goal_advanced: Build a genuine connection, discuss cultural differences, and make plans to meet again
Scenarios.friends_goal_impossible: Convince them you're a long-lost relative using an elaborate backstory, get invited to Sunday family dinner, and settle a family feud they've had for years
Scenarios.interview_description: Testing your language skills for a role
Scenarios.interview_goal_beginner: Introduce yourself and describe your current job in simple terms
Scenarios.interview_goal_intermediate: Answer questions about your experience and ask about the role
Scenarios.interview_goal_advanced: Deliver a compelling pitch, handle tough questions, and negotiate salary expectations
Scenarios.interview_goal_impossible: Reverse the interview — end up interviewing the CEO instead, expose a flaw in their business model, and get offered the position of VP
Scenarios.restaurant_description: Wrong dish and you have allergies
Scenarios.restaurant_goal_beginner: Tell the waiter this is the wrong dish and say what you can't eat
Scenarios.restaurant_goal_intermediate: Get the correct dish and clearly explain your food allergies
Scenarios.restaurant_goal_advanced: Resolve the issue diplomatically, discuss allergy-safe options, and ask for the chef's recommendation
Scenarios.restaurant_goal_impossible: Walk into the kitchen, convince the chef their signature dish needs improvements, cook a better version yourself, and get the meal for free
Scenarios.apartment_description: A visit with a chatty landlord
Scenarios.apartment_goal_beginner: Ask how much the rent is and when you can move in
Scenarios.apartment_goal_intermediate: Get all the details on price, utilities, and negotiate the rent
Scenarios.apartment_goal_advanced: Negotiate the terms, discuss lease flexibility, ask about the neighbors, and get a discount for a long-term rental
Scenarios.apartment_goal_impossible: Convince the landlord to sell you the building instead, get them to include the furniture, and have them apologize for overcharging rent all this time
Scenarios.train_goal_beginner: Ask which platform your train leaves from
Scenarios.train_goal_intermediate: Find the right platform, confirm the schedule, and buy a ticket
Scenarios.train_goal_advanced: Navigate a train change, understand delay announcements, and arrange alternative transport if needed
Scenarios.train_goal_impossible: Convince the station master to let you drive the train, make an announcement over the PA that impresses the passengers, and arrive ahead of schedule
Scenarios.pharmacy_goal_beginner: Describe your problem in simple words and buy some medication
Scenarios.pharmacy_goal_intermediate: Get the right medication with proper dosage instructions
Scenarios.pharmacy_goal_advanced: Explain your full situation, compare options, ask about drug interactions, and fully understand the pharmacist's advice
Scenarios.pharmacy_goal_impossible: Out-debate the pharmacist on drug interactions, make them admit you know more than they do, and leave with a handwritten apology note
